summary: Require machines for acquisition recipes involving fluids.
details: Character crafting no longer supplies recipes with fluid ingredients or results merely because their category matches. Exact typed item-only routes and independently acquired machines remain available.

Fluid-consuming science routes retain their selected machine unlock instead of being flattened to initial availability. Controlled lab, frontier and researchability fixtures preserve the original probability and typed-output assertions with explicit fluid machines.

Native fluid capacity, final emitted catalogue, earned production and existing-save migration remain unqualified. This grants no recipe permission, effect owner, stream identity, setting or compatibility claim.
